exposure: Fetal spine position (anterior transverse vs. posterior)
fetal head position at the time of birth
finding: Fetal spine position appears to play an important role in determining fetal occiput position at birth and mode of delivery, with a higher rate of caesarean sections in the spine posterior group.
mod_finding: The rate of cesarean sections was significantly higher in the spine posterior (SP) group compared to the spine anterior transverse (SAT) group, while the rate of vaginal deliveries without intervention was significantly lower in the SP group compared to the spine anterior (SA) group.
